# cprover.py
                                             
from calliope_mini import pin28, pin29, pin30

def forward():
    pin28.write_analog(v)
    pin29.write_digital(1)
    pin30.write_digital(1)

def left():
    pin28.write_analog(v)
    pin29.write_digital(0)
    pin30.write_digital(1)

def right():
    pin28.write_analog(v)
    pin29.write_digital(1)
    pin30.write_digital(0)

def stop():
    pin28.write_digital(0)

def move():
    left()

def rewind():    
    right()

def setSpeed(speed):
    global v
    v = int(speed / 100 * 1023)

setSpeed(100)

# cpmike.py

from calliope_mini import pin3, running_time, sleep

_click_time = running_time()

def isClicked(level = 10, rearm_time = 500):
    global _click_time
    if running_time() - _click_time < rearm_time:
        sleep(10)
        return False
    v = pin3.read_analog()
    if v < 518 - level:
        _click_time = running_time()
        return True
    return False
